title: RealPolynomialRoots
text:
(source) RealPolynomialRoots A package to find isolating intervals for the real roots of a square free polynomial. Example: julia> using RealPolynomialRootsjulia> ps = [-1, 254, -16129, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1] # mignotte polynomial with two nearby roots8-element Vector{Int64}:
     -1
    254
 -16129
      …

title: RealPolynomialRoots.refine_roots
